Definition: properly, to cut off, i.e. (figuratively) put to death
BiblicalUsage: To cut off is the word for killing: though He slay me, yet will I trust in Him, and the psalmist says, surely Thou wilt slay the wicked, O God.
TheologicalSignificance: I take Job's trust as the centre of the book, because he holds to God in the very verse that says God may kill him.
